theme: An open day to close out the Croatia trip.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is clear today, which leaves room to lock the last Croatia bookings, two of them due today, with the girls back with you and Mike in St. Pete.

needsAttention.title: Lock the St. Pete landing-gap nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA from Croatia Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until Sept 22, leaving Sept 20-21 still unbooked near St. Pete. Also worth a glance that the Sept 27 Airbnb converted from pending to confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Get the Croatia checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy, both legs on Eurowings Discover. Confirm the allowance on the operating carrier's site with the record locator and pre-buy bags, since two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Book the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 night in Cavtat, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30am Sunday flight, is the only unbooked night on the trip and was due Aug 23.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: High summer means fish cooked simply and fast, letting the season's bright produce share the plate.

acts.line: No meetings on the calendar, so the morning is open to settle the two travel items due today before their windows tighten.
The girls are back with you and Mike in St. Pete through early September, an unscheduled afternoon to spend with them.
Nothing booked tonight, a quiet close to the first day of the stretch with the kids.
